meta.title: Create and publish a Traffic Light auction
gaps: Choose the Traffic Light grouping condition.
Assert on the live event that the configured Traffic Light ranges and strategy were persisted.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Choose the Traffic Light grouping condition.; Assert on the live event that the configured Traffic Light ranges and strategy were persisted.

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Select Auction, Traffic Light strategy, entire-lot awarding, and valid lower and upper bounds.
Confirm the selected auction strategy is shown in the configuration screen.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply the first available pricing template required for the auction.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a valid event schedule before publication.
Invite the available vendor audience required for publication.
Save and publish the configured Traffic Light auction.
Assert that publication reached a live project page.
Confirm no publication error is shown.
